name: Weakness, Superior Mass
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level cleric/oracle 7, druid 7, psychic 7, shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as superior weakness except as noted above.
